Each rate = actions ÷ views × 100. All actions = reactions + shares + comments. These are counts, not unique people; rates can exceed 100%. With zero or unknown views, rates are unavailable (—).
Other shares = total shares − public shares reported by Telegram. This is an estimate, not a list of private recipients. Unavailable or inconsistent counts appear as —.
Each percentage is the share of all reactions. Paid reactions count Stars, not people.
